description: Defines the ProxyConfig class and related structures for managing user proxy settings, including automatic and manual configurations, parsing rules, and proxy application logic.

classes.name: ProxyConfig
classes.description: Represents a user's proxy configuration, including automatic and manual rules, PAC URL, and system settings.

classes.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules
classes.description: Encapsulates manual proxy rules, including proxy lists per scheme and fallback options.

classes.name: ProxyConfig::ProxyRules::Type
classes.description: Enumeration of proxy rule types: EMPTY, PROXY_LIST, PROXY_LIST_PER_SCHEME.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::CreateDirect
methods.description: Creates a proxy configuration with direct connection (no proxy).

methods.name: ProxyConfig::CreateAutoDetect
methods.description: Creates a proxy configuration that auto-detects proxy settings.

methods.name: ProxyConfig::CreateFromCustomPacURL
methods.description: Creates a proxy configuration with a specified PAC URL.
